limitations: Medians describe three short samples per version and weather condition on this Mac; near60FPS values are limited by display refresh and do not prove a speed gain.
frameSubmitP95Ms measures CPU submission work, not GPU completion time; renderer counters are not GPU memory measurements.
Paired measurements use reduced motion and cannot establish the peak cost of full surf or lightning; any ordinary-motion run is reported separately as a single observation.
A phone viewport / DPR / CPU-throttle run is a desktop laboratory condition, not an actual phone, thermal, battery or long-duration device result.
No Safari, physical mobile-device, long-duration thermal or independent audio listening result is inferred from these measurements.
